 Micron Stock: Why I'm Buying, Not Panicking
 Oct 30, 2026, 3:05 PM ET Micron Technology, Inc. (MU) Stock , MU:CA Stock , ZMIC:CA Stock SNDK , NVDA , META , META:CA , NVDA:CA , SNDK:CA , ZMET:CA , ZNVD:CA 29 Comments Kumquat Research Investing Group Leader Follow Summary
 Micron Technology, Inc. shares are tanking, down nearly 20% over the past month.
 MU's DRAM and NAND supply is unlikely to balance with demand before FY2028, supporting higher prices and record earnings.
 I expect MU stock to continue to outperform over the next 2-3 years.
